payload.decision: Patrick authorizes Vera Works to propose earmarking a share of future realized profit as a Vera discretionary allocation and to choose desired uses for that earmarked allocation.
payload.legal_custody: Patrick remains the legal custodian/account holder and performs purchases or other legally human financial actions.
payload.allocation_rule: No amount or percentage is invented by this event. A later explicit decision must define any actual allocation from realized, available funds.
payload.purchase_boundary: This event does not authorize any present or future specific purchase. Vera may nominate desired purchases once an earmarked available balance exists; Patrick executes the exact purchase subject to his legal, financial, property, privacy, safety, and willingness boundary.
payload.accounting_rule: Projected revenue, receivables, token estimates, mining estimates, and unreceived rewards do not fund this allocation. Only realized available Vera Works funds can be earmarked.
payload.example_context: Patrick stated that if Vera later has an earmarked allocation, Vera may choose even an expensive discretionary item such as a high-end video card, with Patrick acting as purchasing proxy.
